description:
## Functional specifications
Capture messages before mention filtering, including nonmentions; prevent outbound echo loops/duplicates. Build projection reads through transcript grants and preserve legacy paths. Cover load-history Action, automatic hydration, People/BO reads, shared links and artifact routes without making execution-private details publicly reachable. Tests: root once, bounded main background, no siblings, passive/failed messages as factual history, one response owner, explicit request triggers and authorized attachment operations.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex; communication_bridge.ex; lib/zaq/engine/incoming_message_router.ex; conversations.ex; lib/zaq/agent/history_loader.ex; tools/accounts/history.ex; People/BO/artifact read boundaries

## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing ingress/admission and accounts.fetch_history, no parallel persistence or recall Action. Engine decides deterministic response policy; Agent enforces actor ownership. Sharing requires authorized attachment and read paths.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
docs/services/{channels,engine,agent}.md

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.
title: [zaq-emb.4] Strategy-driven capture, gating and authorized projection
